company.text: Tempus AI (Chicago) combines **molecular diagnostics** (sequencing, MRD testing, FDA-approved xT CDx) with a large de-identified **clinical and molecular data library** used by pharma for discovery and development. In 2026 it launched **Paige Predict** (AI pathology predicting 123 biomarkers from H&E slides) and agreed to acquire **Personalis** (~$1.5B, reported). Its Data and Applications segment grew 33% in Q3 2026.

EBITDA ~$65M. **Data licensing bookings YTD:** >$550M. Well funded; budget is not the issue — the question is strategic fit and who owns antibody work.
